name: drone_a2_sensors
description: Approach/landing fit, WIDE azimuth (issue #13). The elevation-only fit of #7 (drone-a2-sensors-approach.json) fixed the descent geometry but left azimuth at 60 deg, and measurement showed that in a tighter approach it is AZIMUTH that binds first: with S5_START=4.0 the cruising aircraft's first four misses were all 'azimuth -52..-41 deg outside [-30,+30]' while the elevation was already inside the window. So this fit opens azimuth to 150 deg as well -- the bearing to traffic converging on a landing point reaches roughly 50 deg, and 150 deg covers it with margin. points_per_second is scaled by the FULL solid-angle ratio (150x45)/(60x20) = 5.625, i.e. 1500 -> 8438: PointsPerScan() does not depend on the window, so widening two axes at a fixed rate would thin the returns 5.6-fold and make the radar far less sensitive than the baseline it is meant to improve on. Use drone-a2-sensors-approach.json instead when you want to vary elevation alone.
